changes.issue: Suspended work attempt changed suspension state; asynchronous restart could outlive later reset
changes.fix: Preserve suspension; capture restart lifecycle epoch before awaiting termination and check before creating a Worker

changes.issue: Old file reads and failures could replace newer work or selected-file status
changes.fix: Independent file/lifecycle tickets; successful validated run/process invalidates old file reads; UI clears only current selection in guarded finally
changes.verification: Concurrent mounted input tests including failed and repeated file selection

changes.issue: Idle transport death did not notify the lesson through the frozen client
changes.fix: Non-numerical lesson observer for error/messageerror/Node exit; immediate result/held/export invalidation and observer cleanup
changes.verification: Actual idle and active Worker death tests

changes.issue: Nonfinite/no-output chart values could draw false zero markers
changes.fix: Filter paired coordinates before drawing both paths and markers; retain failures in status tables

changes.issue: Typed-array string mapping could show NaN; typed x mapping could silently drop a curve
changes.fix: Array.from before mapping formatted strings or point objects; retain exact source numerical arrays

changes.issue: Ambiguity view phase labels and per-direction residual normalization could mismatch plotted data
changes.fix: Map labels to transformed permutation and normalize each direction by its own actual tensor norm

changes.issue: Display cache could leave charts empty after an export or rejected replacement returned to the same result
changes.fix: Key drawing on both result reference and execution state; restore charts after temporary pending states

changes.issue: View selectors could show out-of-range indices; summary traces could fall back to final factors for an unavailable substep
changes.fix: Synchronize displayed indices to tensor and actual trace bounds; explicitly withhold unavailable substep fit/residual pictures

changes.issue: Unscoped resource examples could be mistaken for a general UI budget
changes.fix: Label earlier13MB/300MiB direct-kernel case; additionally disclose observed25,071,627-byte history and680.4MiB Node process RSS actualUI/Worker case
changes.verification: Independent reviewer resource receipt; no browser claim

changes.issue: A slow reset termination continuation could overwrite newer draft controls
changes.fix: Reset controls synchronously before awaiting old Worker termination

changes.issue: Source generator velocity parameter could be misread as conventional coordinate derivative
changes.fix: Declare actual positive source velocity-to-Doppler map, and physical negative-sign conversion under exp(+j2pi nu t); leave frozen runtime unchanged
